warnings: *** TWO DIFFERENT DETAILS ON THIS SHEET ARE BOTH TITLED แบบขยาย ก, at 1:10 and at 1:5. *** They are not duplicates: the 1:10 is the balustrade panel seen face-on and the 1:5 is a vertical section through its post. Recorded as two elements with ids distinguished by what they show, per §0.3's rule that two different things must never share one element_id. This is the third time this drawing set reuses one title for two views on one sheet (A-10 does it twice, with ราวบันได and หัวบันได), so it is a habit of this draughtsman rather than a one-off.

*** THIS SHEET IS THE TARGET OF THE ราวกันตกดูแบบขยาย CALLOUT ON A-04, which that file recorded with callout_names_no_target_sheet because the note names no sheet. A-17 is the only balustrade enlargement in the set, so the callout resolves here. The A-04 flag stays as a record that the drawing itself does not say so.

THE BALUSTRADE IS TIMBER, sized in inches throughout (4"x4" posts, 1 1/2"x4" top rail, 1 1/2"x3" rails, 1 1/2"x1 1/2" balusters) while its heights are in metres. That mixed-unit convention runs through the whole architectural set and every value is recorded as printed.

SCALE IS PRINTED AS A BARE 25 on รูปขยายด้านหน้า and on แบบขยายบัวฐานเสา (the other view file from this sheet), where every other detail in the set writes 1:25. Read as 1:25; recorded in the file's scale field as the sheet's dominant 1:10 with the anomaly noted here rather than inventing a per-element scale field.
